task.name: pick_cup_on_left_table
task.description: Use the right arm to pick up the green cup and place it on the left table.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the blue cup.
2. Grasp the blue cup with the right arm.
3. Move the right arm to align with the left table.
4. Release the gripper to place the blue cup on the left table.
